review_candidates.title: Senior Nutanix Systems Administrator/Platform Engineer
review_candidates.description: Position Overview MTSI is seeking a senior, hands-on Nutanix Systems Administrator/Platform Engineer to operate, maintain, secure, and troubleshoot, on-premises, Nutanix private cloud infrastructure, supporting our internal classified computing environments. This is an execution-focused systems administration position requiring independent ownership of cluster mechanics, virtualization, storage, Linux systems, upgrades, VM image engineering, and operational recovery. The candidate must be able to diagnose and correct complex problems without extensive vendor or engineering-team direction. You’ll be a great fit for this role if: ( SOFT SKILLS ) You have excellent communication and strong collaboration skills. You have a passion for technology, network systems administration. Proactive problem‑solver able to troubleshoot complex issues across applications, containers, databases, and cluster infrastructure. You understand the Department of Defense cloud native platform initiative and reference architectures. You have exposure to Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, Cloud, and Software Development. You are passionate about continuous learning and growth, and you seek opportunities to challenge yourself. You are driven to make a meaningful impact through your work. ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES* Install, configure, administer, and troubleshoot Nutanix AOS, AHV, Prism Central, Prism Element, Controller VMs (CVMs), hosts, clusters, and virtual machines. Execute daily systems administration: cluster health checks, VM provisioning, resource allocation, snapshots, backup verification, capacity monitoring, and performance tuning. Plan and execute Nutanix Life Cycle Manager (LCM) updates, AOS/AHV/Prism upgrades, firmware maintenance, compatibility checks, and post-change validation; prepare recovery plans. Investigate and resolve cluster service failures, host faults, VM boot issues, storage latency, network connectivity, and hardware or hypervisor incidents. Install and administer Nutanix Unified Storage, including Nutanix Files and Objects, NFS/SMB/S3 access as applicable, permissions, quotas, and storage troubleshooting. Create, customize, secure, and maintain RHEL/Linux and Windows VM golden images, templates, bootstrap VMs, and repeatable provisioning workflows using cloud-init, Kickstart, Ansible, Packer, or scripting. Configure and harden Prism Central, Prism Element, AHV, guest operating systems, and management access, including RBAC, certificates, logging, patching, and DISA STIG/RMF evidence. Troubleshoot VLANs, virtual networking, DNS, NTP, firewalls, storage paths, and host-to-VM communication in coordination with network and cybersecurity teams. Install and maintain Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP) as needed, including bootstrap VM preparation, cluster provisioning, upgrades, and basic Kubernetes operations. Maintain system inventories, configuration baselines, maintenance records, troubleshooting runbooks, and operational handover documentation. Work Location: This position is an on-site role at MTSI’s Alexandria office. On-site 5 days/week. QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline, or equivalent directly relevant experience. 8+ years of enterprise infrastructure or advanced systems administration experience, with substantial hands-on Nutanix administration experience. Demonstrated ability to independently administer and troubleshoot Nutanix AOS, AHV, Prism Central, Prism Element, and cluster services. Hands-on experience executing Nutanix upgrades, lifecycle management, VM provisioning, storage administration, and incident recovery. Advanced RHEL/Linux administration, image creation, automation, and troubleshooting skills. Working knowledge of virtual networking, enterprise storage, system hardening, and disconnected or classified infrastructure. Experience with Nutanix Unified Storage and NKP preferred; Nutanix NCP-MCI/NCX, RHCE, or equivalent credentials desirable. Clearance Requirements Must have a Secret DoD Security Clearance. Citizenship Requirements Must be a US Citizen. The pay range for this position in Virginia is $140,000/year to $170,000/year; however, base pay offered may vary depending on established government contract ranges, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, and other factors. MTSI also offers a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Base pay information is based on market location. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis. This posting will be renewed periodically until the position is filled.

review_candidates.title: Senior Optical Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Overview Founded in 2014, and listed on the ASX since 2015, Superloop’s purpose is to enable better internet for Australian homes and businesses through reimagining how telco should be delivered. We enable challenger retail brands (including Superloop and Exetel brands) to take a larger share of the market, leveraging Superloop’s Infrastructure-on-Demand platform. Superloop provides connectivity and services to customers in three segments of the market: Consumer, Business and Wholesale. Through Smart Communities, we own and operate extensive fibre to the premises (FTTP) and managed Wi-Fi networks that service residential and commercial communities including multi-unit dwellings. Through Neoloop we offer open access to our FTTP networks to other Retail Service Providers. Our offerings leverage Superloop’s investments in physical infrastructure assets that include fibre, subsea cables and fixed wireless, as well as Superloop’s software platforms. Hundreds of thousands of homes and businesses rely on Superloop and Exetel every day for their connectivity needs. Visit www.superloop.com to learn more. Business Unit Overview Our Operations unit is the engine room of Superloop - responsible for maintaining and supporting all of our products and internal technical infrastructure to ensure the best possible service to both our customers and our very own business. Our Operations unit is responsible for ensuring that the business has the technical capability and capacity to deliver services to all Superloop customers ranging from Home Broadband to International Wholesale. Role Purpose The primary goal of the Senior Optical Network Engineer is to ensure the smooth operation of the Superloop network to provide maximum performance and availability to all customers. The Network Engineer is responsible for building, supporting, and maintaining all devices and services within Superloop’s global network. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain Superloop’s optical network infrastructure to support business growth, performance, and reliability objectives. Monitor and optimise optical network performance, proactively identifying and addressing potential issues before they impact services. Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex optical network faults and escalated incidents, ensuring timely restoration of services. Contribute to the planning, deployment, and continuous improvement of optical transport network technologies and architectures. Ensure compliance with network security standards, operational procedures, and industry best practices. Maintain accurate network documentation, configurations, inventory records, and operational procedures. Collaborate closely with Network Operations, Engineering, Projects, Field Services, Vendors, and other business units to deliver network initiatives and operational outcomes. Support capacity planning, network upgrades, technology refresh programs, and infrastructure expansion projects. Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in optical networking and telecommunications. Adhere to all company policies, safety requirements, and compliance obligations. Qualifications And Experience Proven experience designing, implementing, operating, and maintaining carrier-grade optical transport networks. Strong expertise in complex optical networking environments, including DWDM, ROADM architectures, coherent optical transmission, and network automation technologies. Demonstrated knowledge of long-haul, metro, and subsea transmission systems, with a proven ability to perform fault isolation, troubleshooting, capacity planning, performance analysis, and network optimization. Ability to contribute to network architecture and technical design decisions while collaborating effectively with vendors, Network Operations Centre (NOC) teams, project managers, and field engineering teams. Hands-on experience with industry-leading optical networking platforms, including Ciena, Cisco, and PacketLight, with the ability to analyze and interpret optical link budgets, power levels, OSNR thresholds, and transmission performance metrics. Experience with scripting and automation tools to improve operational efficiency and support the development of scalable, reliable, and observable network infrastructure. Minimum 5 years’ experience in the design, deployment, operation, and maintenance of optical transport technologies, including coherent muxponders, fixed-grid multiplexers, ROADMs, optical protection switching systems, EDFA line amplifiers, and submarine line terminal equipment (SLTE). Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, mission-critical telecommunications environment. On Offer Free Home Broadband Free Mobile SIM plan Flexibility – 3 days/week in the office Lunch on Wednesdays, snacks, donuts and more! Diverse and inclusive culture Gain skills and build relationships to succeed in the telco and tech industries, at Superloop and beyond. At Superloop, we’re dedicated to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be who they are. We actively embrace diversity and celebrate the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of our team members. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds to apply, regardless of gender, age, faith, ethnicity, nationality, sexuality, neurodiversity, or physical ability. We’re committed to ensuring that our hiring processes are accessible and inclusive for everyone interested in joining Superloop.
